template_data.headline_html: Five traps that quietly drain your GSA margins.

items.title: No Basis of Award tracking
items.sub: Your GSA rate anchors to commercial prices — know yours.

items.title: No escalation clause
items.sub: Flat rates for five years get eaten by inflation.

items.title: Racing to the bottom
items.sub: Low bids raise questions in a CO's mind, not contracts.

items.title: Undocumented discounts
items.sub: Commercial off-price deals can force Schedule reductions.

items.title: No modification budget
items.sub: Locked pricing costs real money when your business changes.
